meta.source: Brandbook Guates (Crisálida Studio, Oct 2026) and the Guates asset kit

tokens.name: naranja-tostion
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 0 73 100 0. Fills, illustrations, display type. No approved ink reaches 4.5:1 on it: crema-de-papel (3.8:1) only at 24px+ or bold 19px+. Light partner: atardecer-llanero.

tokens.name: cafe-de-origen
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 41 72 80 36, Pantone 469 C/U. Titles and labels on light grounds (7.9:1 on crema-de-papel); the dark ground of the Café theme and the Regional label. Light partner: crema-de-papel.

tokens.name: sol-de-sabana
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 2 11 92 0, Pantone 7404 C/U. Fills, stars, the Honey label. Text on it: cafe-de-origen (5.8:1), verde-moriche or cereza-profunda. Light partner: luz-de-manana.

tokens.name: verde-moriche
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 84 49 85 40, Pantone 553 C/U. The Natural label, illustrations, dark blocks. Text on it: crema-de-papel (8.9:1), luz-de-manana, sol-de-sabana. Light partner: verde-brote.

tokens.name: azul-exploracion
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 87 58 0 0, Pantone 2726 C/U. The Lavado label, section backgrounds, focus ring. No approved ink reaches 4.5:1 on it: crema-de-papel (3.8:1) only at 24px+ or bold 19px+. Light partner: cielo-abierto.

tokens.name: cereza-profunda
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 34 100 43 16, Pantone 208 C/U. The principal logo colour, the Platea label, the primary action in the Crema theme. Text on it: crema-de-papel (8.8:1), luz-de-manana, sol-de-sabana. Light partner: rosa-floracion.

tokens.name: atardecer-llanero
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 0 53 69 0, Pantone 7576 C/U. Light partner of naranja-tostion: fills, pillars, display type on dark grounds (3.0:1 on cafe-de-origen). Best ink on it is verde-moriche at 3.5:1, so display text only.

tokens.name: crema-de-papel
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 4 4 6 0. The paper: page ground of the Crema theme and the light ink on every dark brand colour. Light partner of cafe-de-origen.

tokens.name: luz-de-manana
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 2 6 58 0, Pantone 1205 C/U. Product names on dark labels (6.7:1 on cafe-de-origen), the Honey bag, the seal ring. Text on it: verde-moriche, cereza-profunda, cafe-de-origen.

tokens.name: verde-brote
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 50 12 56 0, Pantone 2261 C/U. The Natural bag, light blocks, illustrations on verde-moriche. Best ink on it is verde-moriche at 4.0:1, so text at 24px+ only.

tokens.name: cielo-abierto
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 44 20 0 0, Pantone 7451 C/U. The Lavado bag, light blocks. Text on it: verde-moriche (4.8:1) or cereza-profunda; crema-de-papel is approved by the brandbook but reads at 1.9:1, so decoration only.

tokens.name: rosa-floracion
tokens.usage: Brand colour. CMYK 0 53 0 0, Pantone 2044 C/U. The Platea bag, light blocks, logo colour on cereza-profunda. Best ink on it is cereza-profunda at 4.1:1, so text at 24px+ only.

tokens.name: negro
tokens.usage: Single-ink logo and illustration on backgrounds from 0 to 50% grey (brandbook greyscale rule). Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: blanco
tokens.usage: Single-ink logo and illustration on backgrounds from 60 to 100% grey or on photography. Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Crema de papel in the Crema theme, Café de origen in the Café theme (like the Regional bag).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, labels, UI text and icons on surface: 7.9:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Long-form paragraphs on surface (the brandbook sets running text in black Roboto Light): 19.0:1 on crema, 7.9:1 on café.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on surface: 5.0:1 on crema, 5.5:1 on café. Derived from cafe-de-origen and crema-de-papel.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers on surface. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill and links: one primary action per view. Cereza profunda on crema (8.8:1), Luz de mañana on café (6.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary action. on-accent stays legible on it (10.7:1 and 5.8:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on an accent or accent-hover fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on surface. An alias of accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour: 3.8:1 on crema, 6.7:1 on café. Used through the focus-ring shadow.

groups.name: Roboto Slab — principal
groups.note: Titles, slogans, product names and highlighted phrases. Thin to Light only at 32px and up; Regular and Medium from 18px; SemiBold to Black from 16px. Google Fonts face.

styles.name: slab-display
styles.sample: Donde empieza otro mapa del café
styles.usage: Hero lines and campaign slogans, often over photography.

styles.name: slab-headline
styles.sample: Porque Colombia cabe en muchas tazas

styles.name: slab-product
styles.usage: Coffee names on labels, product cards and product pages.

styles.name: slab-title
styles.usage: Section titles, set in uppercase in cafe-de-origen (the brandbook's sheet titles).

styles.name: slab-subtitle
styles.sample: El que aún no es conocedor

styles.name: slab-label
styles.usage: Field names on origin sheets and labels.

groups.name: Roboto — secundaria
groups.note: Running text and functional content. Thin from 24px; Light from 16px; Regular and Medium from 14px; Bold from 12px; Black from 14px, short text only. Prefer Regular for long reading.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Seleccionamos cafés frescos de distintos orígenes y compartimos la información necesaria para entender qué hace especial a cada uno.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Primero contamos qué puede sentir o disfrutar una persona; después ofrecemos la información técnica para quien quiera profundizar.
styles.usage: Default running text and product descriptions.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Tostado esta semana. Molienda a pedido.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Values on origin sheets beside slab-label.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase category labels and pillar names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase tags. Bold is the only weight allowed at 12px.

groups.name: Caveat Brush — alternativa
groups.note: The hand-lettered voice: big display words, voice tags, producer names and bag taglines. One weight. Never for paragraphs. Google Fonts face.

styles.name: brush-display
styles.usage: One oversized word per page or slide.

styles.name: brush-note
styles.usage: Producer names, bag taglines, handwritten asides.

spacing.note: 4px base. The brandbook sets no UI spacing; this scale is the system's.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, roast beans.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and between label rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter, block inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: ColorBlock padding, between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and opener padding.

radius.note: Soft corners in the interface, echoing the organic forms of the logo, illustrations and patterns. Square only where the brand reproduces print: the origin label, packaging artwork and ColorBlock compositions. Pills for buttons, voice tags and segmented switches; full circles for seals, discs and dots.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: OriginLabel, packaging artwork (the bag and its label), ColorBlock compositions for print and social, colour swatches in brand sheets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects, small tags, quantity steppers, map labels and other small UI parts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Option chips and tabs inside a strip, callouts, thumbnails and photo placeholders inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, drawers, product fields and media containers (maps, drawings, photography) in the interface.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Button, VoiceTag and segmented switches (the pill holding two or three choices).

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Seal, producer disc, colour dots and note markers.

shadow.note: No drop shadows: the identity is flat colour (and the brandbook forbids shadows on the logo). The only shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px surface-coloured gap, then 2px of focus colour. Apply with :focus-visible.
